visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The man is lying flat on a light-colored tiled floor, wearing a white t-shirt. His face is positioned centrally, exhibiting a wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression of shock or awe. Five hands surround his head, each holding a smartphone with text-filled screens touching his forehead and hair. (2) The man sits in a room with a plain white wall and a poster. Four books are displayed behind him. Grey wires are attached to the books and lead to circular silver sensors taped to the man's forehead. His eyes are rolled upwards, revealing the whites, suggesting a trance-like state during data transfer. (3) The man is seated at a desk with a large open textbook. He operates a massive clear plastic syringe, pulling the plunger to extract knowledge from the page, then inserting the nozzle into his ear and pushing the plunger to inject the information. He flips pages rapidly between injections. (4) The man sits at his desk. He picks up a slice of plain white bread and presses it firmly onto the text of an open book. He then proceeds to eat the bread with extreme speed and intensity, mimicking the Memory Bread concept to absorb the book's contents.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, rhythmic vocal loop featuring a high-pitched, distorted chanting or yelling sound effect plays, establishing a high-energy comedic tone. (2) A sharp, rapid electronic digital zap sound effect triggers, representing a quick data transmission. The BGM remains upbeat and synthesized. (3) The squeak of plastic friction from the syringe is audible, followed immediately by the percussive, high-frequency rustle of paper pages flipping. Short, synthesized pop sound effects sync with the injection movements. (4) Heavy, rhythmic thudding impact sounds occur as bread hits the book, followed by loud, wet chewing sounds. The audio concludes with a bright, high-pitched success chime or ding over a looping synth beat.
